## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, the previous behavior and what happens after this change.

## Implementation

Explain only the choices needed to review the final change. Identify affected flavors, interfaces, permissions, persistent data or connected apps when relevant.

## Validation

List checks actually completed and their results. Separate compile/unit/contract checks from live-provider, APK, emulator and physical-device testing.

## Remaining acceptance or limitations

Name untested paths and material risks. If none are relevant, say so briefly.

## References and provenance

Link related issues/PRs. Identify imported third-party code/assets and relevant AI assistance when useful. Preserve original licenses/notices and omit private data.
